scope: Flora and prop manifest per biome for asset mapping. Every entry carries an image-generation prompt. Not read by the generator: this catalogue is consumed by the art pipeline only, so it is seed-neutral and changing it invalidates no saved world.
art_direction: Magical variants are MATERIAL AND SHADER TREATMENTS of the real biome mesh they name in `base_asset`, not new meshes. Build the real section first; the magical section is 156 treatments over those 63 base assets.

slot_vocabulary.canopy: Tall silhouette; the element that reads from across a valley
slot_vocabulary.understory: Small trees and saplings beneath the canopy
slot_vocabulary.groundcover: The continuous mat underfoot: grass, moss, litter, lichen
slot_vocabulary.detail: Sparse scatter: flowers, ferns, fungi, small accents

id_contract: Magical ids and asset_ids are taken from icarus_sim.terrain_biome_catalogue.biome_catalogue() and must not be hand-edited; see the positional contract in that module.

weave.treatment: Shifting prismatic growth that rewrites its own form mid-reach; edges refract into spectral fringes and no two parts agree

umbral.treatment: Drained to grey bark and ash-black leaf, standing dead but still upright, utterly silent and undisturbed

infernal.treatment: Charred and thorn-wracked, bark split open over ember cores, sulphur crust at the base and smoke staining above

radiant.treatment: Gilded and serene, every leaf edged in warm light, blossom held permanently and never falling

fire.treatment: Ember-veined and smouldering from within, heat-split seed pods cracked open, everything dusted in fine ash

water.treatment: Sheathed in clear ice and constant meltwater, leaves gone translucent, every surface frost-glazed and dripping

earth.treatment: Overgrown to titan scale, bark hardening into stone, enormous root buttresses breaking the ground open

air.treatment: Permanently wind-bent and streaming in one direction, stems hollowed until they sing, scoured bare on the windward side

blood.treatment: Red-veined and faintly pulsing, thick warm sap welling at every break, barbs turned inward

void.treatment: Colour and sound drawn out of it, the silhouette half-erased at its edges, matte black and reflecting nothing

rot.treatment: Swollen with fungal fruiting bodies, wood gone soft and collapsing under itself, spore haze hanging in the air

eldritch.descriptors: madness, wrong geometry, dominion of minds
eldritch.treatment: Grown at angles that do not resolve, branching that reads wrongly from every direction, surfaces that feel observed
